summary: REE Automotive filed a Form 6-K reporting that Israel's Tel Aviv-Jaffa District Court on October 28, 2026 approved, with amendments, a creditors' arrangement under the Israeli Insolvency and Economic Rehabilitation Law (the local equivalent of a Chapter 11 plan confirmation), following an October 25 creditors meeting; the plan is intended to let REE continue as a private going-concern. Two investors, Kukac LLC and Elljay Limited, committed $2 million each ($4 million total) of equity working capital under an October 19 commitment letter, conditional on the arrangement. Watch funding conditions, creditor distribution timing, and post-approval delisting or capital-reorganization mechanics.
